prompts:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Create a transparent-background two-view appearance approval sheet for Aria, a tiny friendly elf resident in STARLIT-GUILD's pixel-style guild home. This is a design preview, not an animation sheet.
Input 1 (aria-v1.png): PRIMARY art-style, head/body proportion, face identity, clothing simplification and compact sprite-size reference. Use the standing idle character in row 2 column 1 as the front-three-quarter pose basis. Input 2 (aria-rear-walk-v3.png): rear-view sprite proportions, line thickness and shading reference only; replace its old long hair and back-cape decorations. Input 3 (aria-reference-sheet.webp): NEW authoritative hairstyle and costume-detail reference ONLY. Do NOT adopt its adult body proportions or smooth anime rendering.
Output: 1536x1024 RGBA, genuinely transparent background. Exactly two full-body characters of the SAME Aria, standing calmly: left, front-three-quarter looking screen right with both eyes visible; right, rear-three-quarter looking away toward screen right. Both views at identical scale, feet on the same baseline, about 660 pixels character height, generous empty gutters and at least 80 pixels transparent outer margins. Empty hands lowered naturally, feet slightly separated, no walking pose. No props, bow or quiver.
Preserve the accepted small chibi proportions, compact torso and boots, relatively narrow face (not a wide round baby face), green eyes and gentle smile, warm dark brown stepped pixel-like outlines, restrained clustered shading and detail density of inputs 1 and 2. The artwork must remain suitable for reduction to a 96-pixel-tall sprite rendered 48 CSS pixels high. Avoid glossy high-definition anime styling, thin wispy lines, and increased head size.
Update appearance to input 3:
- Soft muted golden blond hair cut to shoulder/collarbone length, low volume, short lightly wavy ends. No hair reaching the waist, no flowing long tail.
- One distinct pale lavender lock framing the face on the OPPOSITE anatomical side from the white flower hair ornament. Use input 3 for the side assignment, consistent between views. Make the lock readable as a small coherent color cluster at sprite size; it is hair, not a ribbon. Do not relocate it merely to make it visible from the rear.
- A very small short braid/half-up tie centered at the back, made of only a few thin strands. No thick braided crown, no large braid spanning ear to ear.
- Keep elf ears and the white flower/leaf hair ornament, cream puff sleeves, brown leather corset and belt, green waist cloth and short layered cream skirt, brown gloves and lace-up boots as simplified in the existing sprites.
- Cape back is plain muted green cloth. Gold leaf embroidery only along the front-facing borders, no gold motifs across its back. No dangling metal charms/chains from cape edges. Keep the front flower clasp.
- Simplify the new single diagonal chest strap naturally into the existing costume. Do not introduce intersecting stray straps or extra decorations.
- Chin rests at the collar without an elongated visible neck.
Clean closed silhouette, no cropping, no stray pixels, no text/labels/borders/grid, no floor/cast shadow, no glow/haze, no painted checkerboard. Change only appearance needed for the new design; keep the established guild sprite style.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this transparent two-view Aria sprite design sheet with ONLY two corrections. Preserve both full-body silhouettes, poses, all face features, head and body sizes, hair length and color, clothes, shading, pixel-like line quality, placement and transparent background exactly.
1. Anatomical side consistency: In the LEFT front-three-quarter character the white flower/leaf/feather ornament is screen RIGHT, on Aria's anatomical LEFT; leave that character entirely unchanged. In the RIGHT rear-three-quarter character move the entire flower/leaf/feather ornament from screen RIGHT to screen LEFT, behind/above the left visible ear on that image, so it remains on the SAME anatomical side. Restore ordinary blond hair where the misplaced ornament used to be on screen RIGHT. The lavender face-framing lock on the rear figure remains screen RIGHT (opposite the flower), do not move it.
2. On the RIGHT rear figure only, replace the large ear-to-ear braided arc with a very SMALL SHORT half-up tie centered in the back of her head: two very thin strands gathered only locally near the center, no thick braid or crown spanning the head. Fill the removed wide braid area with ordinary short golden blond hair matching the surrounding hairstyle.
No other changes. Exactly two figures, no text, no shadows, true transparent RGBA. 1536x1024.
